# 2026-09-04 — Page-map sweep: findings

**Companion to `specs/docs/PAGE_MAP.md`** (generated by `scripts/gen-page-map.mjs`, pinned fresh by
`test/page-map-fresh.test.ts`). This file is the *report*: what the sweep over every route of all
four surfaces found. The map is derived from disk and stays current; this report is **dated evidence**
and goes stale the moment one of its items is fixed — close an item here when you close it in code.

Method: four read-only passes (one per surface, plus the shared packages), each finding then
**re-read at the cited line by the main session** before it was written here. Nothing below is a
claim from a summary. Items an agent could not confirm are marked UNVERIFIED and were not counted.

Severity: 🔴 wrong result or silent data defect · 🟠 500 where a 4xx belongs / audit gap · 🟡 hygiene,
doc rot, dead code · ⚪ informational.

---

## 1. Super Admin (`apps/super-admin`) — 11 pages · 1 API · 33 gated actions

Route gates: **all eight `(platform)` pages call `platformRouteGate("<prefix>")` as their first await
and the prefix matches the route** (`route-roles.test.ts` already pins this from the directory). Nav ↔
page parity is complete. Every exported action in `lib/actions.ts` opens with `platformGate(...)`.
No `TODO`/`FIXME`, no `console.log`, no `Date.now()` in a client render path.

| # | sev | where | what | evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SA-1 | 🟠 | `apps/super-admin/lib/actions.ts:980-990` `removeStoreUser` | **Writes blind and logs unconditionally** — the exact class `setStoreUserRole` (:955-972) was fixed for, with a comment saying why. The pre-read has no `storeId` filter; the `delete` does; the audit line is written regardless of rows affected. | A `storeUserId` from another store (or one already removed) deletes 0 rows, returns `{ ok: true }` and writes `"User <other store's email> dihapus dari toko oleh platform"` into THIS store's `platform_activity`. Fix shape is already in the file: `.returning()` + refuse on zero rows, then log. |
| SA-2 | 🟠 | `apps/super-admin/lib/actions.ts:889-897` `setStoreComped` | `update … where id = storeId` with no row check, then `logStore(storeId, …)`. | An unknown store id: `syncStoredStatus` returns `null`, execution continues, and `logStore`'s insert hits the `platform_activity.store_id` FK → thrown `23503` → Next error digest instead of `{ ok:false, error }`. Contrast `suspendStore`/`liftSuspension`, which return *"Toko tidak ditemukan"*. |
| SA-3 | 🟠 | `app/(platform)/toko/[id]/page.tsx:28-42`, `app/(platform)/tiket/[id]/page.tsx:15-17` | **No UUID guard before `eq(table.id, param)`** — `/toko/abc` or `/tiket/1` is a Postgres `22P02` → **500** where `notFound()` belongs. `toko/[id]` fires **eleven** reads in a `Promise.all` before it checks `if (!store)`. | `isUuid` exists only in `apps/admin/lib/uuid.ts`; nothing equivalent in `packages/lib`, so super-admin cannot import it today. AGENTS.md already names this rule for the Seller side (*"`isUuid` before any `eq(table.id, segment)`"*). Move the helper to `@tokophi/lib` and use it on both `[id]` pages. |
| SA-4 | 🟡 | `lib/actions.ts:448-459` `savePaymentChannels` | The one platform-config writer with **no audit line**. It flips `platform_payment_channels.enabled` — the half that checkout actually enforces — while `saveGateways`, `saveCouriers`, `saveCodAllowed` each `logPlatform`, and `saveCouriers`'s own comment records a day of forensics caused by exactly this silence. | Add `logPlatform` naming the channels toggled. |
| SA-5 | ⚪ | `app/(platform)/update-log/page.tsx` | Only `(platform)` page without `export const dynamic` (exports `metadata` instead). Not a defect — `platformRouteGate` → `cookies()` already forces dynamic rendering. | Leave, or add for uniformity. |

## 2. Landing (`apps/landing`) — 9 pages · sitemap

**Clean on every hard rule**: zero `@tokophi/db`/`postgres` reference (only `@tokophi/lib/billing`,
pure, and `@tokophi/ui`); every page has title/description/canonical via `Base.astro`; **no broken
internal link**; sitemap derives from the directory and lists exactly the 8 real pages; **no rupiah
figure or plan name is published at all** (only `BILLING.TRIAL_DAYS`), so nothing can contradict
`billing.ts`; no "Segera hadir", no TODO. The demo host `batiknusantara.tokophi.id` resolves and
answers 200 (checked 2026-09-04).

| # | sev | where | what |
|---|---|---|---|
| LP-1 | 🟡 | `apps/landing/Dockerfile:21-30` vs `src/pages/{index,demo}.astro` | `PUBLIC_DEMO_URL` is read by two pages but is **not an `ARG`** in the Dockerfile, so production can only ever use the hard-coded `https://batiknusantara.tokophi.id` fallback. Works today; a demo-store rename is a rebuild of code, not a build-arg. |

Two lines above it the same file uses `{/* */}`. Harmless, inconsistent — and this repo's rule is that HTML comments in `.astro` reach the browser. |
| LP-3 | 🟡 | `apps/landing/src/layouts/Base.astro:7` | Doc-comment says *"see the naming rule in AGENTS.md"* — no such rule exists in either `AGENTS.md` (root) or `apps/landing/`. Dangling reference; 5 pages carry the `| TokoΦ` suffix, 3 do not. |
| LP-4 | ⚪ | `Dockerfile:27-30` | `PUBLIC_LEGAL_NAME/ADDRESS`, `PUBLIC_CONTACT_EMAIL/WHATSAPP` default to **empty**, so production `/kontak` and `/privasi` render *"Halaman ini belum lengkap"* and the footer says `© TokoΦ` with no legal entity. Owner data, not code — `NEXT.md` already tracks it. |

A reader who opens root `STATUS.md` first is told the project is un-started. Until then a "full run" on any machine carrying worktrees was a 15-minute coin toss, and a red result from one was not evidence about this tree. | `Test Files 68 failed \| 3535 passed (3603)` before · `137 passed (137)` after. Same blind spot as RH-1; removing the worktrees would also have hidden it, which is why the exclude is the right fix regardless. |

`baru`/`[id]` children, `/promo/[id]`, `/promo/html/*`, `/faktur/*` — all reached from a parent
screen). Every mutating server action opens with `requireCapability`. All five public routes read

inside event handlers, never in render. The `@/lib/mock/store` imports (25 client files, 16 data

## 6. Storefront (`apps/storefront`) — 18 pages · 10 endpoints

**Every one of the three layouts renders `MarketingPixels`** (Layout :152, CheckoutLayout :124,
LandingLayout :98). No page reads a store id from body/query — tenant is always `locals`. `track`,
`checkout-session`, `chat/send` all carry `isBot`/rate-limit/body caps; `search.ts` documents its
omission in-file. Every page passes a `title`; canonical present except on CheckoutLayout, by
documented design. `<h1>` on every page except one (SF-9).

| # | sev | where | what | evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SF-1 | 🔴 | `src/pages/feed/google.xml.ts:14-17`, `feed/tiktok.xml.ts:15-18` | **Feeds bypass `locals` and build the origin from the raw `Host`**: `const origin = \`https://${host}\``, re-resolving the store with `getStoreByHost(host)`. Middleware already set `locals.origin = primaryOrigin(store, …)` (`middleware.ts:158`), honouring `x-forwarded-*` and the store's **primary custom domain**. | Under a custom domain the feed's `<link>`/`<g:link>` point at whichever host the crawler fetched (`<slug>.tokophi.com`) while the sitemap and every canonical say the custom domain — Meta/Google/TikTok see two origins for one catalogue. Locally it emits `https://localhost:43xx`. `sitemap.xml.ts:24` does it right: `const { store, catalog, origin } = locals`. Two-line fix per feed. Matters now that custom domains are in flight (`CUSTOM_DOMAIN.md`). |
| SF-2 | 🟠 | `src/pages/api/chat/read.ts` | **No `rateLimit`** — POST that resolves a conversation and runs a `db.transaction` with two UPDATEs, gated only by the signed visitor cookie. `poll.ts:24` and `send.ts:24,63,79,81` each gate. | A visitor with a cookie can drive write transactions at line rate. Add the same `chat:read:ip` limit as `poll`. |
| SF-3 | 🟠 | `src/pages/blog/[handle].astro:84` | BlogPosting JSON-LD publishes the store logo as `abs(store.logoUrl)` — `store.logoUrl` is `/api/uploads/<name>`, served by the **admin** app, so the URL 404s on the storefront origin. | `Layout.astro:85` and `index.astro:119` both use `mediaUrl(store.logoUrl)` and document exactly this. One call. |
| SF-4 | 🟠 | `src/pages/kontak.astro:66-68` · `keranjang.astro:133` · `thanks.astro:62,217` | **Hard-coded per-tenant facts the platform cannot know**: every store publishes *"Jam Operasional Senin–Jumat 09.00–17.00 WIB · Sabtu 09.00–14.00"*; the cart trust line says *"transfer bank & QRIS"* while `index.astro:22-43` derives the same badge from `enabledPaymentChannels()` precisely because the string *"advertised a method the platform has MEASURED being refused"*; `/thanks` shows a static green **ADMIN ONLINE** pill and an English *"Safe Checkout · Quality Guaranteed"*. | Same class as the deleted brand story (`index.astro:272-279`). Drop the hours (or add a setting), derive the cart line from `enabledPaymentChannels()`, remove the online pill. |

## 0. The map itself (found while continuing the sweep, 2026-09-04 09:40 UTC)

| # | sev | where | what | evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| G-1 | 🟠 | `scripts/gen-page-map.mjs` gate detector | **`rate-limit` was never detected.** The pattern was `rateLimited?\s*\(`, which is `rateLimite` + an optional `d` — it cannot match `rateLimit(`. Every rate-limited route (the four `api/public/*`, `chat/poll`, `chat/send`, `checkout-session`, `track`) rendered with an EMPTY gate column, indistinguishable from `chat/read`, which genuinely has none (SF-2). Fixed to `rateLimit(?:ed)?`; regenerated: **8 routes now carry `rate-limit`**, and `chat/read` is the only chat endpoint without a gate — the map now agrees with SF-2 instead of hiding it. | A map column that is empty for a good reason and empty for a bad reason reads the same. The JSON twin (`page-map.json`) is what made this visible: a one-line query for "endpoints with no gate" listed `poll` and `send`, which contradicted the sweep's own notes. |
| G-2 | ⚪ | `specs/docs/page-map.json` (new) | Same facts as `PAGE_MAP.md`, written by the same run and checked by the same test, so an agent can query the map (`routes[].gate`, `routes[].data`, `modules[dir][].exports`) instead of parsing tables. No timestamp on purpose — the output is a pure function of the tree. `npm run page-map` regenerates both. | — |

## 7. Suggested order of attack

1. **AD-3** (2 lines, visible on every store's Pengaturan) · **SF-3** (1 call) · **SF-6** (delete 3 lines) · **SF-10** (import) — trivial, do together.
2. **SA-3 + AD-1** — one `isUuid` in `@tokophi/lib`, applied on eight `[id]` pages across both surfaces; one test that derives the `[id]` page list from the directory so the ninth cannot ship unguarded.
3. **SF-1** feeds → `locals.origin` — before custom domains go live.
4. **SA-1 / SA-2 / SA-4** — `.returning()` discipline + the missing audit line. **AD-2** — `withCurrentTenant` on the media reads.
5. **SF-2** chat/read rate limit. **SF-4** hard-coded tenant facts. **SF-9** `/lp` h1.
6. **SF-5** the 66 HTML comments (mechanical, big diff — own PR). **SF-8** srcset ladders (measure first).
7. **RH-1** worktrees (owner decision) · **RH-2** root scaffolds (owner decision) · **AD-4**, the dead `@tokophi/ui` components and `@tokophi/data` → fold into Task 6.4/6.7.
